Strong coverage additionally requires a digest-valid continuity receipt with no tracked-source drift for the candidate.
A target attestation-only row is routed only when the candidate receipt has its own exact evolution review and every candidate drift row has strong later-current coverage.
The anchor starts at the current raw receipt bytes and does not establish earlier integrity.
Only the exact Game Night report path/schema, verify.js writer, volatile checkedAt field and bounded counts are recognized.
Missing, weak or non-current later evidence remains separately classified.
Later attestation is not treated as intent, correctness, regression absence, or human benefit.
The leaf is pure and historical receipts remain byte-unchanged.
No execution, write, promotion, merge, Foundation or CANON authority is granted.
No later adapter can reconstruct integrity before the external anchor.
